{{Dialogue|Saman|Only other way into the Pangarees is up the Rimma all the way to Corlaasi, then along the Dravin Cut to the Chundu Shunt &mdash;|Fanaso|That's a hike.|Kiardi|Sure is.|attr=[[Saman]], [[Shandy Fanaso]] and [[Kiardi]]|src=<ref name="DTM">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/triton20080820.html|text="Deader than a Triton Moon"|int=Deader than a Triton Moon|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
The '''Chundu Shunt''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] accessible via the [[Dravin Cut]]. It was a gateway to [[The Pangarees/Legends|the Pangarees]].<ref name="DTM" /> The Chundu Shunt shared its name with the [[Chundu system/Legends|Chundu system]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=|other=the Chundu Shunt|system=[[Chundu system/Legends|Chundu system]]|homeworld=|canon=|legends=1}}</ref> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
